pages.text: The crowned king of the Underthrone holds court in the $(l)Hollow Throne$(), a hall on its own rock. Everyone in your party standing nearby enters with you.$(br2)He fights with $(l)Kingsbane$(), shard volleys and a wide spin.

$(l)Phase 1$() (100-66%): sword work and volleys.$(br)$(l)Phase 2$() (66%): he calls his court of ghouls and a stalker and starts using $(l)Crownfall$(). He kneels and drives Kingsbane into the floor, and shards fall where each hunter stood. Watch for the gold rings and move.

$(l)Phase 3$() (33%): full enrage. A barrier soaks damage, and shards also rain on their own between attacks.$(br2)After he falls, the hall sends you back to camp. If you leave the hall empty, he resets.
